deviceTokenTips: Devices with the same token will discover each other
deviceAddStep1: 1. Click the `Traffic` menu -> `Device` -> `Device QR Code`, or open the `Device` sidebar and click the QR Code icon on your desktop app.
deviceAddStep2: 2. Scan the QR code displayed on the desktop app, or input address manually.
deviceAddStep3: 3. Wait for device connection and data synchronization to complete.
deviceAddTips1: If multiple IPs are detected on the desktop, please manually select the IP address in the same LAN as the mobile.
deviceAddTips2: Windows desktop needs to set the network type to private network instead of public network in system settings.
deviceAddTips3: Please ensure Settings -> Privacy -> Local Network -> Reqable is enabled.
deviceCollaborationMobileTips: When forwarding traffic from other devices to current, it is recommended to turn off VPN mode.
deviceConnectFailedMessage: Connection failed, please check your device network status and try again!
deviceSyncFailedMessage: Sync failed, please check your device network status and try again!
deviceQrcodePrepareMessage: You are about to enter the QR code scanning page, please open the QR code on the Reqable desktop.
deviceCertificateWarningNotSame: The device uses a different root certificate than the current application. It is recommended to keep it consistent!
deviceCertificateWarningNotInstall: The device's root certificate is not installed, which will cause network connections to fail!
deviceCertificateWarningNotTrust: The device's root certificate is not installed into the system certificate directory, which may cause some network connections to fail!
deviceInputAddressTips: Please enter the device's IP address and port number.
deviceDeleteAlertMessage: Are you sure to delete this device? You need to scan the QR code again to add this device!
deviceSyncCertificateAlertMessage: Do you confirm to synchronize the CA certificate of this device to the mobile? This will replace the existing CA certificate of this app!
deviceSyncApiDataAlertMessage: Do you confirm to synchronize the API collections and environments of this device to the mobile? This will replace all the current data!
deviceUpgrade325Tips: The version of {platform} Reqable is lower than 3.2.5, which may cause some features to be unavailable, please upgrade to the latest version!
deviceCertificateNotMatch: Different root certificate from this app
deviceCertificateMatched: Same root certificate as this app
deviceCertificateStatusNotInstall: This root certificate is not installed on the mobile
deviceCertificateStatusInstalled: This root certificate has been installed on the mobile
deviceCertificateStatusSystemInstalled: This root certificate has been installed on the system
deviceCertificateStatusUserInstalled: This root certificate has been installed as a user certificate
